#### Mayor

#### Bill Ray

[Email Bill Ray](mailto:mayor@cityofhauser.us)

I am proud and honored to be serving as your Mayor and a member of Hauser City Council for over 10 years.  One of my priorities has been to keep and maintain our “small town feel” in this picturesque community I love to call home.

I am a recently retired Administrative Sgt from the Rathdrum police department where I served for 30 years. I now have time for the pleasures in life with my family and friends.

#### Council Seat 1

#### Jeff Hoerner

[Email Jeff Hoerner](mailto:citycouncil1@cityofhauser.us)

City council memeber for 4 years, overseeing the Public Works Dept.

I am a life long Idaho resident and have lived in Hauser for the past 5 years but have been visiting since the 70s. Professionally, I’m a landscape contractor with 42 years experience in the Inland Empire.

![](https://cityofhauser.us/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Mark-CC-Photo.jpg)

#### Council Seat 2

#### Mark Duchesne

[Email Mark Duchesne](mailto:councilseat2@cityofhauser.us)

I am honored to join the Hauser City Council. As a retired business leader and a long-time property owner in Kootenay County, I recently became a full-time Hauser resident.  It is a privilege to serve this community, and I am eager to collaborate with the mayor and my fellow council members to ensure that the quality of life in Hauser aligns with the expectations of its citizens.

#### Council Seat 3

#### Alice Pomakaly

[Email Alice Pomakaly](mailto:citycouncil3@cityofhauser.us)

I moved to Hauser in June 2019 from a suburb of Los Angeles, where I was born and lived most of my life prior to Hauser.  
I am very happy to become a resident in this beautiful area and find people friendly and helpful to their neighbors. I felt joining Council would be a way to give back to this community.

#### Council Seat 4

#### Daniel Finley

[Email Daniel Finley](mailto:councilseat4@cityofhauser.us)

Daniel focuses on special projects and community building.  
I have been a resident of North Idaho for 14 years and Hauser for 3. I work as a digital marketing and business development contractor, and volunteers with LoveINC and Kootenai Strong.
